hypothesis_label: Compression release quality as a pre-expansion confidence gate

mechanism_contract.known_baseline_weakness: The current baseline can confirm only after visible expansion and does not explicitly rank the quality of compression-release preparation before the move.
mechanism_contract.exact_mechanism_of_improvement: Introduce a pre-move release-quality state that scores compression cleanliness, release alignment, and false-release contamination before expansion confirmation.
mechanism_contract.why_not_parameter_tuning: The change is a new pre-expansion classification layer rather than a threshold or weight adjustment on an existing state.
mechanism_contract.why_expected_edge_should_survive_strict_: If real, the edge should appear as cleaner pre-move separation and lower approval of noisy compressions, not as a one-window parameter bump.

required_evidence_inputs: deterministic compression width or range-tightening evidence
deterministic release alignment evidence available before full expansion
allowed_scope: release-cleanliness classification before visible move confirmation
optional secondary compare against phase68i_dynamic_ladder_candidate for overlay/context suitability only
forbidden_scope: post-move trade management or leverage ladder changes
generic threshold sweeps without a new state definition
